bullets: ROC is a graph showing the performance of a classification model at all classification thresholds.
This curve plots two parameters: [1] True Positive Rate [2] False Positive Rate
True Positive Rate (TPR) is a synonym for recall and is therefore defined as:
Correctly Predicted as Positive / ALL Actual Positive Samples (Percentage of correctly retrieved Positive samples)
False Positive Rate (FPR) is defined as:
Incorrectly Predicted as Positive / ALL Actual Negative Samples (Error percentage in samples Predicted as Positive)
An ROC curve plots TPR vs. FPR at different classification thresholds.

layout.arrangement: Title centered at top with slide number '28' in yellow circle at top-right. Intro paragraph and parameter line below title on left. Two stacked sections (TPR then FPR) in middle: each has a bold blue lead-in line, a red-bordered formula box on the left, and a red-bordered definition box on the right. Final sentence at bottom left.
